Getting Started

Welcome

Solitaire is classic Klondike tuned for Even Realities G2: scroll, tap, and double-tap. Tiny gesture set, big card energy.

Launch

On launch, the app restores your latest valid save. If there is no save, it deals a fresh shuffle.

  • Restores game state when a save exists
  • Restores your Move Assist setting with the save
  • Move Assist is on by default for a new install. Turning it off sticks.
  • After a win, tap starts a new game

What This Covers

This page mirrors current in-game behavior: controls, menus, prompts, save/resume, and Klondike rules as implemented in this build.

Board Layout

Core Piles

  • Stock: Face-down draw pile. Tap to draw three cards.
  • Waste: Face-up draw pile. Only the top card is playable.
  • Foundations (4): Build each suit from Ace to King.
  • Tableau (7): Main play columns, built downward in alternating colors.

Focus Navigation

Focus is your cursor. It moves by mode:

  • Browse mode skips empty piles and skips foundations
  • The stock stays reachable while it or the waste still holds cards. Once both are empty, scrolling skips it too
  • Destination mode moves across tableau and foundation drop targets
  • With Move Assist ON, illegal destinations are skipped
Note: Foundations are skipped during browse mode, but are available during placement.
Controls

Three touchpad gestures run the table. A fourth, the G2 system-menu gesture, opens the options menu.

Scroll Navigate focus between piles and destinations (and the Yes/No of the Reset confirm).
Tap Select, place, draw, or confirm. Context decides.
Double Tap Cancel an active selection, or close the Reset confirmation.
Menu (system gesture) A short press, then a long press opens the G2 system menu, where Solitaire lists Move Assist, Draw Card, Play Animation, and Reset.
Note: The options menu is the glasses' own system menu now, drawn by the OS. Pick an option there and Solitaire runs it. Double-tap no longer opens a menu.

Tap Behavior by Context

Focus / State Tap Action
StockDraw three cards. When the stock is empty and the waste still has cards, the waste recycles and the same tap deals. On the last pass, when three or fewer cards are left in the whole cycle, the recycle takes its own tap so you can see the stock refill.
WasteSelect waste top as source. With Move Assist ON, focus auto-jumps to a legal foundation first; if none exists, it jumps to the leftmost legal tableau destination.
TableauSelect as source, or place a carried run. With Move Assist ON, focus auto-jumps to a legal foundation first, then to the leftmost legal tableau pile. It stays put when the pile has more face-up cards below the top one, so you can still tap to grow the run. Placement always needs a second tap.
FoundationWhile carrying cards, attempts placement to that foundation (legal moves only).
Reset ConfirmConfirms the highlighted Yes / No of the Reset prompt.
Win StateStart a new game.
Gameplay Flow

Basic Move Flow

  1. Scroll to the source pile (stock, waste, or tableau)
  2. Tap to draw or pick up cards
  3. With Move Assist ON, focus may auto-jump to a legal destination. A foundation wins when one is legal, otherwise the leftmost legal tableau pile.
  4. Tap again to place

Finishing a Game

Once the stock and waste are empty and every tableau card is face-up, every remaining card is headed for a foundation.

  • With Move Assist ON, focus moves to the next pile that can go home after each card lands. You can finish the game on taps alone, no scrolling.
  • Scrolling still reaches every pile, so you can park a card on another column first if you need to.
  • With Move Assist OFF, a tap on a tableau card sends it straight home in one step.

Selecting Tableau Runs (Multi-card Moves)

In destination mode, tapping the same tableau column cycles carried run size (1, 2, 3, ... up to visible count, then back to 1).

Think of it as a built-in run-size dial, no extra gesture required.

Invalid Moves and Canceling

  • An illegal placement shows Invalid move and returns focus to the source pile
  • If a selected source has no legal moves, the info panel shows 0 Legal Moves
  • Double-tap cancels the current selection and returns to browsing
Rules (Klondike Solitaire)

Official Rules Reference

Baseline reference: Standard Klondike. Solitaire keeps that rule core and adapts interaction for G2 gestures.

Objective

Move all cards to the four foundations, building each suit from Ace to King.

Initial Deal (Implemented)

  • Seven tableau piles are dealt with 1 through 7 cards
  • Only the top card in each tableau pile starts face-up
  • The remaining cards form the stock

Foundation Rules

  • Start with an Ace
  • Build upward in the same suit (A to K)

Tableau Rules

  • Build downward in rank with alternating colors
  • Move valid face-up runs between tableau piles
  • Only a King (or a run starting with a King) can move to an empty tableau column
  • When the top face-down card is uncovered, it is flipped face-up automatically

App-Specific Clarifications

  • Board draw: Tapping the stock draws three cards (or fewer when fewer cards remain)
  • Menu draw assist: The menu's Draw Card option draws one card (and handles recycle first when needed)
  • Auto-destination priority (Move Assist ON): A legal foundation wins. Otherwise focus goes to the leftmost legal tableau pile. A tableau pile with more face-up cards below its top card keeps focus instead, so the run-size tap stays available. Placement always needs a confirming tap.
  • Recycle: The waste can be recycled when the stock is empty. Draw order carries through the recycle, exactly as in standard Klondike.
  • Win condition: You win when all four foundations have 13 cards
Tip: Move Assist is on by default. Leave it on while learning, since it skips illegal destinations for you.
Stuck on the last few cards? Draw order never changes through a recycle, so with three cards left the same one keeps coming up. The menu's Draw Card pulls a single card, which shifts the order and reaches the other two.
Menu Options

Open the G2 system menu with its gesture (a short press, then a long press). Solitaire adds these options to it; choose one and it runs.

Move Assist

On by default. Filters where focus can land while you are carrying a card.

  • On: Destination scrolling skips illegal drops, focus auto-jumps to the best destination, and the endgame advances pile to pile on its own
  • Off: You can scroll to any tableau or foundation destination

Draw Card

Draws one card from stock as an assist action. This is separate from board stock draw, which draws three. Use it to shift draw order when the last few cards keep repeating.

Play Animation

Replays the winning card cascade on demand. Started this way it runs over your game in progress, so the panel labels it Preview and a tap skips back to your game. Nothing about the board changes.

Reset

Shows a Yes/No confirmation in the info panel before starting a new game. Scroll to choose, tap to confirm, double-tap to cancel.

Status & Feedback

Info Panel

The panel on the left of the display is the only status readout. In normal play it shows:

  • Move Assist: ON or Move Assist: OFF
  • A legal move count for the focused pile, shown whether Move Assist is on or off. 0 Legal Moves is how you spot a dead pile.
  • The focused pile's label and its cards. The stock also shows Cards Left.
  • Selected Pile and the card or run you are carrying

When Space Runs Short

The panel fits nine rows. When both the focused pile and a carried selection are listed, the Move Assist and legal-move lines step aside to make room. Long card lists shorten with a ... line rather than running off the bottom.

Other States

  • Reset confirm: RESET GAME with a Yes/No prompt, the choice marked by >. (The options menu itself is drawn by the glasses' system UI, not this panel.)
  • Win: You win! and Tap for new game
  • Animation started from the menu: Preview and Tap to skip
  • Brief messages such as Invalid move and Stock reset appear at the top for a moment
Save & Resume

Autosave

The app autosaves game state and Move Assist. Saves are queued and debounced so gameplay stays responsive under load.

Persistence

  • Even Hub / G2: Uses the bridge storage API
  • Browser fallback: Uses localStorage

Resume on Launch

On startup, valid save data restores both game state and Move Assist before initial state is finalized.

Debug Console (Perf Panel)

A floating panel that prints performance output while you play.

Panel Controls

  • Hide / Show
  • Clear
  • Copy All
  • Stop / Start, to pause or resume recording

When It Appears

The panel is hidden by default and appears when DOM perf logging is enabled in src/perf/log.ts (for example, PERF_LOG_DOM_ENABLED).

Tips & Notes

Playing Efficiently

  • Leave Move Assist on while learning. It cuts destination-scrolling noise.
  • If a tableau selection looks wrong, double-tap to cancel and reselect.
  • Tapping the same tableau column while carrying cards changes the run size.
  • Watch for newly exposed tableau cards. The app flips them automatically.
  • Check the legal move count before committing to a pile. 0 Legal Moves means it is dead for now.
  • When the endgame starts, stop scrolling and just tap. Move Assist walks the piles for you.
